items.title: Define metrics once and keep them correct with the dbt Semantic Layer on Amazon Redshift
items.summary: Amazon Redshift has no native semantic layer, yet teams still need consistent, governed metric definitions across BI tools. This post shows how to define a metric once with the open-source dbt Semantic Layer (MetricFlow) on Amazon Redshift so it stays correct at any grain, and proves a non-additive weekly average comes out right ($280, not $550).
items.creator: Isabelly Rocha

items.title: Assess and track your Amazon Redshift RA3 to RG modernization with CUDOS
items.summary: The CUDOS 5.10 dashboard adds an Amazon Redshift RA3-to-RG section that helps you assess the cost-efficiency opportunity of moving to Graviton-based RG instances, track adoption as your instance-generation mix shifts, and quantify the gains already achieved on RG.
items.creator: Alex Peshekhonov
